sb_prompt: FIND OUT THE OTHER CALLERS' PREFERENCE AND LEVEL OF INTEREST IN PERSONAL COMPUTERS.  HOW DOES IT COMPARE TO YOUR INTEREST AND PREFERENCE?
turns: So, what's the deal with computers for you? I just want to know if you're into them or if you mostly just hate the screens.
Honestly, I actually enjoy them? I used to hate them, but now I love how I can look up anything instantly when I'm stuck on a table.
That's wild, I can't imagine working without Google sometimes!
Wait, tell me about it—what's the weirdest thing you've had to look up for a customer?

Oh my god, last week I had to look up what a "liquor license" actually was because a woman in her seventies kept trying to buy a bottle of vodka for her husband's funeral and she wouldn't stop asking.

That actually sounds like the weirdest thing I've heard, but I had a customer ask if I could make a "steakhouse special" that included a live chicken and an actual cow, and I had to explain that's not how biology works to her.
No way, that's insane, but honestly my weirdest one was when an old man asked me if I could deposit his pension checks in a baggie because he thought the bank was a grocery store.
Yeah, that is absolutely ridiculous, but have you ever had to explain why you can't just print money at the counter?
Actually, that's a weird question because we're not allowed to print money, but have you ever had to explain how checking accounts work to someone who thinks they're real cash?
That actually makes sense now, but I still have a friend who thinks if you hold a dollar bill really tight it turns into real currency.
That's hilarious, but have you ever had to explain to someone why your phone isn't a gift card?
Yeah, but have you ever had to explain why your computer can't print money too?
Haha, that's actually the funniest thing I've heard all day, but honestly no one's ever asked me that yet!
No, but have you ever had to explain why your bank card works like a debit card when it's actually just plastic?
No way, that's the craziest thing I've heard! Actually, have you ever had a customer ask if your computer can actually calculate their tax return for free?
That is actually a great question, because I have to explain that to a lot of tourists every day, but usually they just want to know if I can figure out their state income tax instead.
No way, but honestly I've never had a customer ask me to file their taxes, just someone asking me to deposit a bunch of rocks because they thought they were gold bars.
Haha, rocks for gold bars? That's the craziest thing I've ever heard!
Haha, yeah, that's actually the strangest thing I've heard all day!
Oh my god, rocks instead of gold? That's the weirdest thing I've heard in years!
Oh wow, imagine trying to file taxes on rocks, that would be a nightmare!
Yeah, that sounds like a total nightmare.
Yeah, I bet you'd have a hard time filing taxes on stones though.
Yeah, that would be a nightmare for sure.
Yeah, I bet that would be a total disaster, but hey, at least you get to explain it to people who actually want to eat steak and drink beer!
That sounds pretty exciting, but honestly I usually just deal with people who don't know how to use a credit card at all.
Yeah, but have you ever had to explain why your computer can't actually process a real credit card swipe?
That's actually true, but have you ever had to explain why your computer can't actually accept a physical dollar bill?
No way, have you ever tried to scan a real bill and watched it just bounce back?
Wait, no, my register machine actually scans the real paper money just fine, but it can't make new ones, only count what's already there.
Yeah, that makes sense, but do you think your machine would get confused if someone handed you a fake $100 bill?
Yeah, but have you ever tried to scan a fake bill and saw it just get rejected?
Yeah, but have you ever seen someone try to slide a fake bill through the card reader and watch it spit it right back out?
Yeah, mine would definitely flag it instantly though!
Yeah, that would definitely set off the alarm!
Yeah, mine doesn't flag it unless it's just a blurry photo, but honestly that's enough to make their day ruined.
Yeah, but my machine would definitely flag it instantly though!
Mine just says "NOTE" on the screen, which apparently confuses the old lady enough to make her cry.
Oh man, that sounds like a nightmare, but at least you get paid for it!
